verdict.rationale: Column says it lets you build card programs with any type of card, and a Column engineer confirms it is an issuing bank sponsoring Visa/Mastercard programs with physical and virtual cards. However, the docs say it works through partner issuer processors, so card issuance appears to need a third-party processor rather than the same account API. Missing for 10: evidence of card issuance through Column's own API tied to accounts, spend controls, digital wallet (Apple/Google Pay) support, and in-depth card API docs.
